name: Fresh (Terminal IDE)
description: Installs the Fresh terminal text editor / IDE from the official sinelaw/fresh GitHub release as a static musl prebuilt binary. Assumes 'ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/common-utils:2' has run.

version.description: Fresh version. 'latest' (default) resolves the newest GitHub release, or pin an exact version ('0.4.1' / 'v0.4.1').
